name: entd-embed
description: ENTD Embed — no-code drawing buttons for site builders (Tilda, Webflow, Squarespace…) and plain HTML.

scripts.build: npm run build:prod && npm run build:staging
scripts.build:prod: cd .. && API_HOST=api.entd.tech WEB_HOST=entd.tech npx webpack build --mode production --output-path embed/build/prod && cd embed && cat build/prod/index.js src/entd-embed.js > build/entd-embed.js
scripts.build:staging: cd .. && API_HOST=api.aientd.space WEB_HOST=aientd.space npx webpack build --mode production --output-path embed/build/staging && cd embed && cat build/staging/index.js src/entd-embed.js > build/entd-embed.staging.js
scripts.publish:frontend: npm run build && (cd ../gtm && npm run build) && sh bin/publish-frontend.sh
